doc.title: Bob Wilber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998

title: Thanks and goodbyes
summary: Closing thanks and congratulations on the honorary degree.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well listen, we definitely have to get together again but on behalf of the college I want to thank you for joining us.
Oh thank you Monk, it’s been a pleasure.
And congratulations on the degree you got this weekend.
Oh I’m honored, I really am.
I’m looking forward to hearing you play tomorrow night.
